title: Seat quantity sync and proration preview
goal: Seat quantity management for Team workspaces: change seats via PATCH /seats, return a Stripe-computed proration preview with ?preview=true, and keep Stripe quantity, billing records and max_seats in agreement with seat accounting.
scope_in: PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}/seats {seats} (billing:write; owner/billing; Idempotency-Key accepted): updates the add-on seat item quantity (seats minus included 5) on the Stripe subscription with proration.
?preview=true: calls Stripe invoice preview and returns amounts without changing anything.
Lower bound: seats may not drop below seats in use (members + pending invites) from B030 seat accounting; upper bound configurable (default 500).
Applying the result immediately through B070 upsertFromStripe and B069 applySubscriptionState (idempotent with the later webhook).
Reconciliation job `billing.seats.reconcile` (daily) comparing Stripe quantity with the stored seats and seats in use, repairing drift and logging mismatches.
scope_out: Seat accounting and enforcement on invites: B030.
Checkout and portal: B071. Webhook ingestion: B072. Entitlement derivation: B069.
Pro plan (fixed at 1 seat; seat changes return 409).
build_against: StripeGateway fake with scripted previewInvoice/updateSubscriptionItems (B070 interface), SeatAccountingPort fake returning seats in use, Postgres container for subscription rows.
interfaces: PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}/seats?preview=true {seats} -> 200 {seats, preview:{amount_due:Money, proration:Money, next_invoice_at:string|null, lines:{kind:'proration'|'recurring', amount:Money}[]}}  (no state change)
SeatService.change(workspaceId, actor, seats, idemKey): Promise<SeatResult>; preview(workspaceId, seats): Promise<SeatPreview>; reconcile(workspaceId): Promise<{drift:boolean, repaired:boolean}>
acceptance: preview=true returns amounts as {amount:int, currency} Money objects, performs zero Stripe write calls (fake records none) and leaves DB rows unchanged.
Increase from 5 to 8 seats on Team calls Stripe once with quantity 3 on the add-on item and proration_behavior create_prorations; response max_seats = 8 and entitlements rev increments by 1.
seats below seats-in-use (e.g. 4 with 6 members) returns 409 with a stable conflict code and no Stripe call; seats 501 returns 422; non-integer returns 422.
On Pro or free workspaces PATCH returns 409 (single-seat plans); on a canceled or none status returns 409.
Same Idempotency-Key + body replayed returns the same response (Idempotency-Replayed: true) and one Stripe update; different body with the same key -> 409 `idempotency_conflict`.
Roles: owner and billing succeed; admin/member/guest get 403 (CT-RBAC: change seats is owner/billing only).
Reconcile detects Stripe quantity 10 vs stored 8, updates stored seats and entitlements, and reports drift; running again reports no drift.
Stripe failure leaves stored seats unchanged and returns 503 with retry_after_s; no partial entitlement change.
guardrails: MUST NOT reduce seats below members plus pending invites; check and Stripe update MUST be serialised per workspace (advisory lock) to avoid racing invites.
MUST NOT apply a seat change locally before Stripe accepts it.
MUST send an idempotency key to Stripe derived from the request Idempotency-Key.
Preview MUST NOT mutate Stripe or DB state under any circumstances.
Money MUST be integer minor units; no floating point arithmetic on amounts (use Stripe's values).
failure_modes: Stripe accepted the update but the response was lost -> retry with same idempotency key returns the same result; reconcile also heals.
Invite accepted concurrently while decreasing seats -> lock makes one of them win; loser gets 409.
B030 port unavailable -> fail closed (503), never assume zero seats in use.
